Show the current lyric in the media notification. Some Android versions use system-rendered media metadata instead.

Adjust width, text size and position to avoid the clock, camera and system icons.
Experimental Flyme compatibility, off by default. Requires system support; turn it off if the media notification looks abnormal.
Native status lyrics are currently adapted for Meizu Flyme. Use floating status lyrics on this device.
Applies to both status modes. Uses the parsed translation, including lines with the same timestamp.
